title: Pre-release UI smoke tests for the dead-picker class, and a release gate that actually runs them
description: Shipped 1.3.0 with the LoRA and upscale pickers dead in Model Settings (8184709b: MpiDropdown/MpiTreePicker portalled to body at MOUNT, so a picker built inside a body-mounted MpiOverlay before show() was swept into the overlay stash). Same surface broke once before (MPI-356: overlay in the #tool-container stacking context painting under the picker, plus an exponential open() reopen loop). Nothing runs at release today - release:check is static file consistency, CI dispatches a build, and the 80 green unit tests plus 8 desktop specs are never gated. This card adds desktop smoke specs for that bug class and makes both suites a release gate.
acceptance: tests/desktop/popup-contract.spec.js mounts MpiDropdown + MpiTreePicker inside a body-mounted MpiOverlay BEFORE show(), and asserts each popup is a direct body child, is not inside .mpi-overlay-stash, has a non-zero rect, and is hit by elementFromPoint at its centre
NEGATIVE CONTROL A proven live: restoring the eager mount-time portal in MpiDropdown makes popup-contract.spec.js FAIL on the stash asserts, and it passes again once the fix is restored

tests/desktop/model-settings-popup.spec.js opens MpiModelSettings the production way (state.currentProject plus open with a modelId) and applies the same four assertions to the settings overlay, the first LoRA tree picker and the upscale dropdown
model-settings-popup.spec.js also guards MPI-356: open() is called exactly once after a 1s settle, and console.error / pageerror counts are zero
NEGATIVE CONTROL B proven live: dropping the _same() guard in assetService.loadAll makes the open-call-count assertion FAIL, and it passes again once restored
tests/desktop/workspace-sweep.spec.js walks the surfaces reachable with empty user data and asserts each mounts with no pageerror
tests/desktop/launch.js is the shared launch plus console/pageerror collector helper; the 8 pre-existing specs are NOT touched
npm test and npm run test:desktop are both green, and both are a mandatory pre-build step in .claude/skills/mpi-version-bump/SKILL.md with a matching note in mpi-release/SKILL.md
A follow-up card exists for the CI workflow, naming the @cubric/connector file dependency as the blocker
